name: Mars
about: The whole planet, from the mosaic of Viking orbiter photos. The colors were added by its makers, they are not what a camera saw.
source: USGS Astrogeology Science Center, Mars Viking Colorized Global Mosaic 232m (MDIM 2.1), public domain. Colorized by NASA Ames. Image data: NASA/JPL/USGS
